title: Add a per-candidate duplicate-check (must_be_unique) validation on the Family de
description:
[The user currently has the "Candidate Onboarding Record" screen open (object emponb_candidate_record, type T). Resolve "this", "this form/page/screen", or "here" to this object unless they name a different one.]

In "Candidate Onboarding Record" and "Candidate Self" pages, when adding new record under "Family" section, 
it should not allow records with duplicate Member Name and should show the validation message if duplicate member 
name is added.
